notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Boa Constrictor's ability by tapping it, giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
